Elias, keeper of the grey lighthouse for thirty-one years, made his usual patrol of the tideline and spotted it: a green bottle sealed with wax, half buried in kelp. He broke the seal with his knife and unrolled a page soft with seawater. The handwriting was faint but legible, dated forty-seven years before, and signed with a name he knew well, his own father's, lost at sea before Elias was born. The note asked whoever found it to light one extra lamp for a son the writer would never meet. Elias read it twice, folded it against his chest, and climbed the spiral stairs with tears freezing on his cheeks.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。街道空旷，路灯把湿漉漉的柏油路照成一条发亮的河。二十四小时便利店的玻璃门透出暖黄的光，店员打着哈欠整理货架。远处，洒水车缓缓驶过，留下清凉的水雾；早点铺升起第一缕白色蒸汽，擀面杖敲击案板的声音格外清晰。写字楼零星亮着几扇窗，像未睡的星。高架桥上偶有出租车驶过，尾灯拖出短暂的红线。这座庞大的机器终于放慢呼吸，而清洁工人已穿好橙色背心，悄悄把城市重新擦亮，等待第一缕晨光降临。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a problem solves a smaller version of itself, like opening nested dolls until you reach the tiniest one.\n• A stopping rule, called the base case, tells the process when to stop so it does not repeat forever.\n• Each stopped step hands its answer back to the step before it, and those answers combine into the final solution."}
